stem.en: The epics present the ideal of a good person and ruler "as one who works for the welfare of all beings". A village tank is shared by rich and poor farmers. Which ruler fits this ideal?

text.en: A ruler who repairs the tank only for the farmers who pay him the most.
A ruler who sees that the tank serves all the farmers, rich and poor.
A ruler who lets the poor farmers' channels run dry, to please the rich.
A ruler who gives the tank to his own family.

explanation.en: The epics present goodness as non-discriminatory and hold up the good person and ruler "as one who works for the welfare of all beings". Only one of these rulers acts for all the farmers.

hints.en: Which ruler treats no group of farmers as less important?
